title: Pizza
desc: Michael, a pizza delivery boy, lives with Anu, an aspiring horror fiction writer. One day, while delivering food, he goes to a bungalow where mysterious events begin to take place.

title: Kutti Puli
desc: A principled individual inadvertently spoils a contract killer's scheme. Later, he unwittingly becomes the focus of the hitman's vengeful fury.

title: Tik Tik Tik
desc: The Indian Space Research Organisation recruits Vasu on a special mission where he and his team must stop an asteroid advancing towards Earth.

title: Dev
desc: Dev, an adventure enthusiast, falls in love with Meghna, an entrepreneur with a troubled past and insecurities. As a result, his life changes.

title: Thiruchitrambalam
desc: Thiruchitrambalam, a young man, scarred by past tragedies, navigates love and personal growth while managing strained family dynamics and unresolved grief.
